description: This file defines a React component 'PanesSystemComponent' that manages a multi-pane UI layout, including navigation, content list, and editor panes. It handles pane rendering, animations during pane transitions, resizing callbacks, and responsive layout adjustments based on device type.

methods.name: computeStylesForContainer
methods.description: Calculates CSS styles for the pane container based on the number of panes and device type, enabling responsive layout adjustments.

methods.name: computeClassesForPane
methods.description: Determines CSS class names for individual panes, including handling of transition states and device type.

methods.name: computeClassesForContainer
methods.description: Returns CSS class name for the overall container, adjusting for mobile or desktop layout.
